HODITH · Bright theme review

Soft Glow, five screens

Coral/turquoise, the pair you picked. Gradient-washed cards, blurred icon halos, hairline borders, and — after the last round of notes — a warmer, primary-tinted ink instead of near-black text anywhere in the app. Home and Edit Case join Big Picture, Case Detail, and Settings below.

Planks keep Settings' existing outlined-card structure but pick up the gradient wash; segmented controls (theme, check-in interval) get the same pill-glow "on" state as Case Detail's tabs, so one selected-state idiom covers both.

Same scope note as before: visual spikes, Voice strings unchanged (every label above is a real string from Voice.kt's Bright/Quirky voice), nothing wired up. Big Picture's day-cell glow replaces the existing sticker-fan treatment in BigPictureGrid.kt's BrightDayCell — worth flagging since that one already shipped, unlike the rest.
